description: This file defines the FineractEntityAccess class, which models entity-to-entity access permission mappings within the Fineract financial platform. It includes properties for entity types and IDs, access type, and methods for creation, JSON deserialization, and updates.

classes.name: FineractEntityAccess
classes.description: Represents the access permissions linking two entities, including the access type and associated entity identifiers. Supports creation from parameters or JSON, and can be updated via JSON commands.

methods.name: createNew
methods.description: Creates a new FineractEntityAccess instance with specified entity types, IDs, and access type.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Constructs a FineractEntityAccess object by extracting parameters from a JsonCommand using specified JSON input parameters.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the properties of the current FineractEntityAccess instance based on changes detected in a JsonCommand. Records and returns the actual changes made.
